DIAGNOSIS READY: Patellar Tendinitis (Jumper's Knee) or Patellofemoral Pain Syndrome.

The clinical picture of localized knee pain without hip tenderness, combined with completely normal blood work and imaging (X-ray, MRI, ESR, CRP), effectively rules out septic arthritis, Legg-Calvé-Perthes disease, slipped capital femoral epiphysis, and malignancy. The symptoms are most consistent with an overuse injury.
